method: Independent code review of narrow path/hash/receipt/diagnostic exception, followed by Linux repeated execution of the producer-authored ten regression controls.
review: Every selected non-exempt Python source must compile; exactly one immutable historical parse failure must still fail at its bound line/message. Missing, changed or newly valid fixture rejected; no producer source executed.
limitations: The ten tests reuse producer-authored controls; they are repeated execution, not a second independently authored test suite.
